they-dont-listen.name: Being heard
they-dont-listen.line: The people in charge don't listen to people like me.
they-dont-listen.why: Keeps the same complaint but says it the way people do ("they don't listen"), and the name says what is missing instead of the civics word "Representation".

democracy-slipping.name: Democracy
democracy-slipping.line: I worry our democracy is slowly slipping away.
democracy-slipping.why: The ID names democracy slipping, but the current line drifted to institutions in general; this brings it back to what the pain is about, calmly and without doom.

democracy-slipping.name: Institutions
democracy-slipping.line: I see courts, elections and a free press being worn down.
democracy-slipping.why: Keeps the broader institutions framing but names which ones, so the line is something a person can picture rather than an abstraction.

corruption.name: Money in politics
corruption.line: I see the rules bend for people with money.
corruption.why: Every other name under Government is an area (Taxes, Voting, Local control); "Corruption" is the only problem label, and this area name keeps the same line.

taxes-dont-buy-much.name: Taxes
taxes-dont-buy-much.line: I pay more in taxes and get less back in services.
taxes-dont-buy-much.why: The current line never says what is paid or what comes back; naming taxes and services makes it clear on its own.

far-away-decisions.name: Local control
far-away-decisions.line: Decisions about my town get made by people far away.
far-away-decisions.why: "Decisions about here" reads awkwardly; "my town" is how a person would say it out loud.

immigration-broken.name: Immigration
immigration-broken.line: I see an immigration system that's broken, and nobody fixes it.
immigration-broken.why: The current line is hedged ("I don't think... working well"); this says it plainly, matches the ID, and people on any side of the debate could say it.
